verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides an official CUDA Toolkit with C/C++ compiler, runtime libraries, GPU-accelerated libraries, and new CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python APIs plus Nsight profiling tools, directly enabling developers to build AI-native software against official SDKs on RTX 5070 Ti hardware, and the developer.nvidia.com portal is confirmed live via llms.txt probe. Missing for 10: detailed API reference docs or code samples, independent developer corroboration of SDK usability, and resolution of 404s for machine-readable docs/OpenAPI endpoints.
